verdict.rationale: Grafana documents provisioning and observability-as-code, which keep dashboards, data sources and other configurations in version-controllable files deployed through CI/CD with automated testing, and a CLI suited to CI/CD pipelines. Review and rollback are only implied by relying on external Git workflows, and alert rules, the core automation, are not explicitly named as covered. Missing for 10: explicit alert-rule/automation versioning, a native review or approval flow, a documented rollback mechanism, independent hands-on corroboration.
